speaker: Mr Desmond Choo
text: asked the Minister for National Development how can the Ministry support Town Councils to help residents with water seepages and wear and tear problems at common areas of HDB estates.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Residents who encounter water seepage from external walls in their flat typically report it to the Town Council managing their estate.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: For example, there may be cases where Town Councils have carried out repairs but the water seepage issue persists despite the Town Councils' efforts.
